case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's central location and, in several reviews, comfort (comfortable beds, good room temperature), clean rooms and attentive staff. Recurring criticisms noted aging, worn facilities, limited lighting and poor soundproofing; breakfast feedback was mixed (one review praised it, another called it limited). Cleanliness comments varied—one reviewer reported dusty furniture—and one isolated review mentioned a disruptive group in the evening.
